user.title: Add container
user.description: How should the container be added?

scan.title: Read Zwilling QR code
scan.description: Scan the QR code on the container (e.g. with a shortcut) and paste its content here. Alternatively the ID alone is enough (value of `cc`, e.g. `34OL`).

create.title: Create new QR code
create.description: A new unique ID is generated (format `HA-XXXXXXXX`) that cannot collide with Zwilling codes. Afterwards you find the matching QR code as an image on the device, ready to print and stick on.

reconfigure.title: Rename container
reconfigure.description: Container ID: {cc}. The ID stays, printed QR codes and NFC tags keep working.

error.invalid_code: No valid ID (cc) found in the QR code.

abort.already_configured: This container has already been added.

nothing_to_reset.message: No entity to reset is available for this container (contents, best before and filled on are disabled?).

ai_unavailable.message: The Home Assistant “AI Task” integration is not set up.

no_content.message: Enter the contents of the container first.

no_area.message: Assign an area (storage place) to the container first so the estimate fits the place.

estimates_disabled.message: Best-before estimates are switched off. Enable them under Settings → Devices & services → Larder → Configure.

table_no_match.message: There is no entry for these contents in the shelf-life table. Enter the best-before date yourself or choose “Table, otherwise AI” in the settings.

table_unknown_storage.message: The area “{area}” cannot be matched to a storage place. Name it e.g. fridge, 0 °C compartment, freezer or pantry, or add a temperature sensor to the area.

table_unsuitable.message: {food} should not be stored in “{place}”, so no date is estimated.

entry_not_found.message: This remembered entry no longer exists.

nfc_tag_in_use.message: This tag is already linked to “{name}”. Unlink it there first.

recipe_photo_failed.message: The recipe could not be read: {error}

recipe_photo_none.message: No recipe was found in the photo.

recipe_photo_unsupported.message: The selected AI cannot read photos or files. Pick an AI task in the settings that supports attachments.

recipe_photo_no_media.message: Home Assistant has no media folder; the photos are stored there briefly.

init.title: Settings
init.description:
**Best-before estimate**
Controls how the “Estimate best before” button on the dashboard and the service work. The built-in table works without an AI service and without internet. AI uses the service you set up under Settings → Devices & services → “AI Task”; only the contents, the area name with its hints (temperature sensor, label description), vacuum yes/no and the filling date are sent. Values you corrected yourself always win.

**Scan webhook**
Enter this URL **once** in the iOS shortcut. It is secret: anyone who knows it can look up containers.

`{webhook_url}`

Path only: `{webhook_path}`

See the project README for the shortcut instructions.

data_description.vacuum_default: New containers start with the “Vacuum” switch on or off. Existing containers keep their value. Switch it off if most of your boxes are not vacuum-sealed.
data_description.estimate_mode: Shows the “Estimate best before” button on the dashboard unless set to Off.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Only needed if you have set up more than one AI service and an AI option is chosen.
data_description.opened_days: The “Opened” button on the dashboard shortens the best-before date to at most this many days from today.
data_description.thawed_days: The “Thawed” button on the dashboard shortens the best-before date to at most this many days from today. Do not refreeze thawed food.
data_description.calendar_entity: Writes each container's best-before date to this calendar as an all-day event (create, move, delete). The calendar must support creating and deleting events, e.g. Google, CalDAV or “Local Calendar”. Leave empty = off.
data_description.nfc_notify: When someone scans a linked tag, their phone (Companion app) gets a notification. Tapping it opens the container in the dashboard.
data_description.repair_hints: Shows hints under Settings → System → Repairs for containers without an area, filled containers without a best-before date and containers that expired at least 7 days ago.
data_description.temperature_warning: Warns (repair hint and event larder_temperature_warning) when a storage place with a temperature sensor stays too warm: freezer above −12 °C for 30 minutes, fridge above 8 °C or 0 °C drawer above 6 °C for 60 minutes.
data_description.todo_entity: A to-do list of Home Assistant (e.g. “Shopping list”, Todoist, Bring!). When a container is emptied and its “Shopping list” switch is on, its contents are added to this list (not twice). Leave empty = off.
data_description.meal_calendar: Optional: planned dishes appear there as an all-day event “🍽 …”. Without a calendar they are only in the dashboard.
data_description.thaw_days: How many days before the planned day the summary reminds you of containers in the freezer (0 = on the day itself).
data_description.experimental_panel: Second sidebar entry for trying new features before they reach the normal dashboard. At the moment it is the same as the normal Larder dashboard.
data_description.recipe_days: Recipe ideas "from leftovers" use containers that expire within this many days (0 = today only). In the dashboard you can change the period for a single request or turn it off.
data_description.soon_days: From this many days left a container counts as "expiring soon" (hint in the dashboard, filter, sensor status and the default for the expiry overview).

error.calendar_not_supported: This calendar cannot be used: Larder must be able to create and delete events. Use for example "Local Calendar", Google or CalDAV.

estimate_best_before.name: Estimate best before
estimate_best_before.description: Estimates the best-before date from the contents, storage place (area), vacuum and filling date – using the built-in table and/or AI depending on the settings. An existing best-before date is never overwritten unless “Overwrite” is on.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Write the estimated date to the container. Off: only return the suggestion.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Estimate even if a best-before date is already set.

clear_best_before.name: Clear best before
clear_best_before.description: Removes the best-before date of the container.

clear_filled_at.name: Clear filled on
clear_filled_at.description: Removes the filling date of the container.

get_expiring.name: Get expiring containers
get_expiring.description: Returns all containers whose best-before date is near or has passed, with a ready-made text for notifications (response: count, expired, items, summary).

days.name: Days
days.description: Containers with a best-before date within this many days. Without a value the "Expiring soon" setting applies.

include_expired.name: Include expired
include_expired.description: Also list containers that have already expired.

mark_opened.name: Mark as opened
mark_opened.description: Shortens the best-before date to at most the given number of days from today. Without a date, one is set. Defaults to the setting “Shelf life after opening”.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days from today (empty = value from the settings).

mark_thawed.name: Mark as thawed
mark_thawed.description: Shortens the best-before date to at most the given number of days from today, for food that was just thawed. Without a date, one is set. Defaults to the setting “Time after thawing”.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days from today (empty = value from the settings).

suggest_recipes.name: Suggest recipes
suggest_recipes.description: Asks the AI for recipe ideas that use up containers whose best-before date is near. Returns the recipes and a short summary. Needs the “AI Task” integration; only contents, quantity, remaining days and storage place are sent. Expired containers are left out.

days.name: Days ahead
days.description: Use containers that expire within this many days. Without a value the period from the settings applies.

servings.name: People
servings.description: Scale the recipes for this many people (empty = 2).

max_recipes.name: Number of recipes
max_recipes.description: How many ideas to ask for (1–5).

all_containers.name: All containers
all_containers.description: No period: use every filled container, also those without a best-before date (never expired ones).

containers.name: Containers
containers.description: Use exactly these containers (devices), whatever their best-before date. Expired and empty containers are never used.

rebuild_calendar.name: Clean up calendar
rebuild_calendar.description: Re-syncs all best-before events in the selected calendar and removes duplicate or orphaned events.

include_unmarked.name: Also remove events without marker
include_unmarked.description: Additionally removes events without a Larder marker that are titled "MHD: …" or "Best before: …" (e.g. when the calendar drops descriptions). All events are then recreated.

get_statistics.name: Get statistics
get_statistics.description: Returns statistics from the history (eaten, thrown away, share thrown away, most frequent contents, storage time) and the current inventory.

days.name: Days
days.description: Only emptyings of the last so many days. Empty: all.

containers_without_area.title: Larder: containers without an area

area.title: Assign areas
area.description: Choose the area each container stands in. Containers left empty stay without an area.

filled_without_best_before.title: Larder: filled containers without a best-before date

estimate.title: Estimate best-before dates

long_expired.title: Larder: containers expired more than {days} days ago

empty.title: Empty expired containers
empty.description: The ticked containers are emptied and recorded as thrown away in the history.
